title: How to Build a Forum or Discussion Board with AI (No Code Required)
summary: Build a fully functional forum — threads, replies, upvotes, user accounts, and moderation — without hiring a developer or touching a database. Database and auth included.
body_markdown: Yes. Both patterns are describable in plain language. For Reddit-style: *"Users upvote and downvote threads. The homepage shows threads sorted by vote score minus age (hot sorting)."* For Discourse-style: *"Users can mark replies as solutions. Threads gain trust-level-based visibility based on engagement."* Blink generates the appropriate database schema and UI for each.
